title: Closed two-study temperature descriptive juxtaposition v1.0
description: Exactly the named Ciganas/Zach source groups; separate central-only plots and always-visible SD text. No matched-condition inference or calculated uncertainty endpoints. Runtime additionally rebuilds against current catalogs: schema/digests alone do not establish canonical provenance, scientific validation or publisher-artifact identity.

evidence_values.name: Fiberlogy PA12 CF15, FFF-printed horizontally with alternating +45°/-45° raster
evidence_values.scope: This commercial filament and horizontal alternating-raster FFF preparation; not neat PA12, all PA12 CF15 products, an isotropic bulk resin or all print orientations.

printing_parameters.infill_interpretation: 100% is the reported infill setting; it does not establish measured zero porosity.

evidence_values.infill_interpretation: 100% is the reported infill setting; it does not establish measured zero porosity.

evidence_values.geometry_role: Nominal specimen context only; no reconstructed stress-area calculation or thickness conversion.

evidence_values.interpretation: The displacement-rate unit supports a crosshead-rate reading, not force rate or measured local strain rate.

evidence_values.moisture_status: Moisture after drying and before testing was not measured. Drying does not establish a measured dry-state specimen.

evidence_values.name: Bambu Lab PAHT-CF; annealed FFF specimens; ±45° infill
evidence_values.matrix: polyamide 12 (PA12), as described by the authors

evidence_values.storage: dehumidified storage; dehumidified AMS during printing

printing_parameters.infill_interpretation: Reported print setting, not measured zero porosity or isotropy.

evidence_values.postanneal_cooling: natural-convection cooling to room temperature in a vacuum-sealed dehumidified container
evidence_values.preparation_wording_ambiguity: Section 2.2 describes annealing for all specimens while Table A1/Section 2.3 distinguish groups. Only explicitly annealed rows are admitted; untreated history is not inferred.

evidence_values.infill_interpretation: Reported print setting, not measured zero porosity or isotropy.

evidence_values.geometry_role: Drawing context only; no area, strain-rate or gauge-length reconstruction.

evidence_values.interpretation: As printed; no silent correction to mm/min, crosshead-channel assumption or local strain-rate conversion.

count_definition_source.verified_as: Reported 10 mm/s displacement rate, five specimens per orientation × temperature × annealing group and 30-minute thermal-chamber conditioning

notes: Four condition summaries share one selected preparation/protocol; they are not four independent studies.
No SD formula, raw replicate independence or uncertainty of the median is inferred from the reported group count.
